basic_details.job_title: IIT Indore Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Design & Research Assistant Posts
basic_details.short_information: The School of Innovation at the Indian Institute of Technology Indore has 1 Design & Research Assistant post in a 1-year research project on Madhubani folk art. The project is funded by the Young Faculty Research Seed Grant (YFRSG) IIT Indore. The fellowship is 20000/- and the essential qualification is BDes/BFA. To apply, email your CV and portfolio to [email protected] by 28 October 2026. Shortlisted candidates will be interviewed on 30 October 2026.

how_to_apply: Applications are by email only. Send your CV and portfolio to [email protected] by 28 October 2026. This is the last date of applications printed in the notice.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice prints "NA" for the age limit. It invites "interested and motivated candidates". The skills and interests the role needs are listed in the job description below. For the discipline-specific eligibility of the post, check the official notification.

rows.desirable: Background in Design or a related discipline

content_sections.heading: IIT Indore Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists the following for the Design & Research Assistant: Willingness to participate in field visits in the Bihar region for research and documentation. Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator and Adobe InDesign. Interest in folk art, visual documentation, cultural heritage, and design research. Research Paper writing The appointment is for 1 Year in the project "Digital Documentation and Authenticity Assessment Tool Development for Madhubani Folk Art: Towards Cultural Heritage Preservation." under the School of Innovation.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Indore Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are by email only. Send your CV and portfolio to [email protected] by 28 October 2026. This is the last date of applications printed in the notice. CV Portfolio

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview. The interview date is 30 October 2026. The notice does not mention the interview venue, mode or reporting time. Selected candidates will be informed by email.
